# bursar

> Declarative credit calculation and billing engine for AI SaaS — metering, prepaid credits, plans and allowances, and subscriptions over one PostgreSQL schema, from identical Python and JavaScript SDKs.

Bursar gives AI applications one place to meter usage, sell prepaid credits, run plans and allowances, and orchestrate subscriptions. A single strict versioned config drives pricing operations, rate cards, credit buckets, entitlements, plans, quotas, and auto-recharge guardrails; all money is exact decimal on an append-only PostgreSQL ledger, served by identical Python and JavaScript SDKs. Start with the Quickstart, then read the data model, pricing, plans, and configuration concepts.

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/intro): Reusable credit ledger and billing engine for AI SaaS — one config, two SDKs, exact money on one PostgreSQL schema.
- [Quickstart](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/quickstart): Ten minutes to a working credit ledger — install the schema, publish a config, grant credits, and charge for usage.
- [Agent Skills](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/agent-skills): Install the bursar skill for coding agents in one command — metering, credits, plans, quotas, and billing done right.

## Core Concepts

- [Data model](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/concepts/data-model): Accounts, the append-only ledger, lots, leases, and allowances — mapped to tables on one PostgreSQL schema.
- [Configuration](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/concepts/configuration): The strict, versioned BursarConfig document — operations, rate cards, credits, plans, and validation.
- [Pricing](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/concepts/pricing): How usage becomes money — operations, measures, rate cards, and price rules with exact decimal charges.
- [Expressions](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/concepts/expressions): The safe expression language for pricing formulas — allowlisted functions and operators, shared by both SDKs.
- [Plans](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/concepts/plans): What a paid tier gets — allowed operations, rate cards, free credit allowances, features, and quotas.
- [Billing](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/concepts/billing): How billing connects the credit ledger to a payment provider — offers, events, and auto-recharge guardrails.
- [Architecture](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/concepts/architecture): The Bursar facade and its capabilities — credits, catalog, accounts, billing, and commerce over the Postgres schema.

## Guides

- [Credit lifecycle](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/guides/credit-lifecycle): Follow one user's credits from signup to ledger — grants, purchases, charges, refunds, expiry, and revocation.
- [Financial safety](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/guides/financial-safety): The financial invariants Bursar enforces at the account boundary — exact money, atomic leases, and idempotent mutations.
- [Multitenancy](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/guides/multitenancy): One PostgreSQL schema for every tenant — mandatory tenant_id columns, row-level security, and composite foreign keys.
- [Subscription integration](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/guides/subscription-integration): Turn provider lifecycle events into canonical credit mutations — subscriptions, invoices, offers, and auto-recharge.
- [Storage backends](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/guides/storage-backends): PostgreSQL is the production credit store; ClickHouse and S3 adapters ingest high-cardinality data through the outbox.

## CLI

- [CLI](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/cli): The bursar CLI — migrations, tenant lifecycle, config validation and publishing, plus deployment notes.

## Python API

- [Overview](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/python-api/index): The bursar Python SDK — Bursar facade, credit manager, pricing engine, and pluggable stores.
- [PricingEngine](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/python-api/pricing-engine): The bursar PricingEngine — database-free pricing from a canonical config, with UsageMetrics and CostBreakdown results.
- [Credit manager](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/python-api/credit-manager): The bursar credits service — balances, metered charging, leases, plans, ledger history, analytics, and teams.
- [Stores](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/python-api/stores): bursar stores — PostgresStore, PostgresBillingStore, and the CreditStore contract for custom backends.

## JavaScript API

- [Overview](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/javascript-api/index): The bursar JavaScript SDK — Bursar facade, credit manager, pricing engine, and pluggable stores.
- [PricingEngine](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/javascript-api/pricing-engine): The bursar PricingEngine — database-free pricing from a canonical config, with UsageMetrics and CostBreakdown results.
- [Credit manager](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/javascript-api/credit-manager): The async bursar credits service — balances, metered charging, leases, plans, ledger history, analytics, teams.
- [Stores](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/javascript-api/stores): bursar stores — PostgresStore, PostgresBillingStore, and the CreditStore contract for custom backends.

## Examples

- [Why bursar and setup](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/why_bursar_and_setup): End-to-end setup: install, schema migration, tenant creation, and the first credit grant.
- [First pricing config](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/first_pricing_config): Write, validate, and publish the canonical pricing config.
- [Pricing engine](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/pricing_engine): Price UsageMetrics without a database using the PricingEngine.
- [Expression language](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/expression_language): The safe expression language for rate cards and price rules.
- [Credit lifecycle](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/credit_lifecycle): Grants, charges, refunds, expiry, and revocation as ledger entries.
- [Plans and allowances](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/plans_and_allowances): Free plans, monthly allowances, and admission policies.
- [Quotas and spend caps](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/quotas_and_spend_caps): Quotas and hard spend caps enforced atomically.
- [Credit tiers and expiry](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/credit_tiers_and_expiry): Tiered credit buckets and expiry windows.
- [Leases and financial safety](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/leases_and_financial_safety): Atomic reserve/settle leases for long-running jobs.
- [Teams](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/teams): Multi-user accounts, member spend caps, and team charging.
- [Analytics](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/analytics): Ledger analytics, spend by user and model, and aggregation queries.
- [Events](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/events): Credit lifecycle events and event delivery.
- [Subscriptions and auto-recharge](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/subscriptions_and_auto_recharge): Subscriptions and auto-recharge guardrails.
- [CLI and deployment](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/cli_and_deployment): The bursar CLI and deploying configs in production.
- [Custom stores](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/custom_stores): Roll your own CreditStore backend.
- [Pricing config schema](https://zonastery.github.io/bursar/docs/notebooks/pricing_config_schema): The full pricing config schema, end to end.
